named_method: Unified autoregressive framework with decoupled visual encoding
definition: Use a shared autoregressive Transformer core while separating visual pathways so that understanding-oriented image encoding and generation-oriented visual tokenization are not forced through a single identical encoder bottleneck.
assumptions: Full-scale training is infeasible in the current workspace due missing torch/transformers.
A method-faithful prototype can still evaluate architectural consequences and image-specific task fit.
The two supplied images act as canonical understanding-side probes.
invariants: single shared Transformer core remains autoregressive
visual encoding is decoupled by task role
framework supports both understanding and generation
comparison baseline is a single visual encoder
non_negotiable_steps: represent separate visual routes for understanding and generation
evaluate both multimodal understanding and visual generation capability at least by proxy
deviations: No end-to-end transformer training or inference due unavailable deep learning stack.
Generation capability is assessed by architectural proxy scoring rather than image synthesis outputs.
